title: Short- and long-term outcomes of photodynamic therapy in oral potentially malignant disorders
html: This study evaluated the efficacy of 5-aminolevulinic acid photodynamic therapy (5-ALA-PDT) in 94 patients with oral potentially malignant disorders (OPMDs). Patients were treated with 20% 5-ALA and 635 nm laser light at 100 J/cm2 every 1–3 weeks, followed by at least 1 year of follow-up. Among the 94 patients, 36.2% achieved a complete response, with an overall response rate of 92.6%. Factors predicting better short-term efficacy included good oral hygiene (P = 0.042), no baseline pain (P = 0.025), single lesions (P = 0.025), lesion size <2 cm2 (P = 0.002), and the use of topical incubation (P = 0.004), particularly for ≥2.5 h (P = 0.002).
